scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm, I'm sorry if I made
a big scene when you grazed
me with that attack accidentally. It's just that I was training so
diligently and blood sugar was incredibly low and the fatigue...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
嗯，抱歉，刚才你不小心用攻击蹭到了我，我可能反应有点过激。
只是我训练得太刻苦了，加上低血糖和疲劳...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hah! Admit it,
old man! You were
just scared! Me, on
the other hand...
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哈哈！承认吧，老头子！你刚才只是被吓到了！
而我呢...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You little
whippersnapper!
I don't know what
you're talking about!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
你这小鬼头！
我不知道你在说什么！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I recognize you
from somewhere,
I think. Reidin, do you
remember this guy?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
我觉得我好像在哪里见过你。
雷丁，你记得这家伙吗？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Oh come on, we see
hundreds of Archers and
Hunters and Snipers and...
I can't remember them all.
But I guess this guy's up
to snuff. Trust me on this!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哎呀，我们见过成百上千的弓箭手、猎人和神射手...
我怎么可能都记得。
不过我觉得这家伙挺厉害的。相信我！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Alright, alright.
If Reidin thinks you're
worthy, then you're probably
are. In that case, I'd like to
offer to teach you my secret
skill, ''Phantasmic Arrow.''
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
好吧，好吧。
既然雷丁觉得你够格，那你应该确实不错。既然如此，我想传授给你我的绝招，“幻影箭”。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait, wait. This guy
only needs a refresher.
Yeah, I'm pretty sure you
were here to learn this
skill before. Yeah, I've
got a gut feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等，等等。这家伙只需要复习一下。
没错，我相当确定你之前来过这里学习这个技能。
没错，我有种预感。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Damn. Only a refresher?
That means you'll learn
this free of charge. Alright...
You should be able to use the
Phantasmic Arrow skill now.
Travel safely now, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
该死。只是复习？
那意味着你可以免费学习。好吧...
你现在应该可以使用幻影箭技能了。
路上小心，听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hm? You're back?
Oh, did you bring
everything? Ah, you did.
Good! Now I shall reveal
my super secret skill...
The 1st Arpesto Form!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
嗯？你回来了？
哦，你把东西都带齐了吗？啊，带了。
很好！那么我要展示我的超级绝招了...
阿尔佩斯托第一式！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Wait! Wait...
Didn't you call it
Arpesto's 3rd Form
or something at first?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
等等！等等...
你刚才不是叫它阿尔佩斯托第三式之类的吗？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Er, yes, Arpesto's
3rd Form, that's right.
It's just there's just so
many of them, that... 
Anyway, let me teach you
the ''Emergency Arrow'' skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
呃，是的，阿尔佩斯托第三式，没错。
只是招式太多了，所以...
总之，让我教你“紧急箭”技能。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Whoa, hold on!
''Emergency Arrow?!''
That's the old name you
gave that skill, right?
Didn't you change it?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
哇，等一下！
“紧急箭”？！
那是你以前给那个技能起的名字，对吧？
你不是改过名字吗？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
What the hell
are you talkin--
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
你他妈在说什--

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Oh, you're right.
We agreed that name
was too cheesy. What
did we call it now? Um...
''Phantasmic Arrow?''
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
哦，你说得对。
我们之前同意那个名字太俗了。那现在我们叫它什么来着？嗯...
“幻影箭”？

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Umm....
Ummm........

[Reidin Corse]
Yeah, that was the one!
''^3131FFPhantasmic Arrow^000000'' sounds
soooo much cooler than that
other name you came up with!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
没错，就是那个！
“^3131FF幻影箭^000000”听起来比你之前想的那个名字酷多了！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
You can be pretty handy
sometimes, Reidin. Now,
back to the matter at hand.
I shall teach you my awesome
skill, Phantasmic Arrow. Now...
Ready your mind and body!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
雷丁，你有时候还挺有用的。好了，回到正题。
我要教你我的强力技能，幻影箭。那么...
准备好你的身心吧！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
Phan-!
Ta-!
Ssssss-!
Mic-!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
ARRRRRRRROOOOOOW~!

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*^000000
Alright, I used a special
technique to teach you the
skill-- directly into your brain. You should be able to use it
now. Why don't give it a try?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
^333333*呼哧呼哧*^000000
好了，我用了一种特殊技巧，把技能直接灌进了你的大脑。你现在应该可以使用它了。不如试试看？

scripts.text:
^3355FF*Swwwwwww!*
*Bang!*^000000

[Arpesto]
^333333*Pant Pant*
*Cough Cough*
*Cough Cough*^000000

[Arpesto]
WHHHHHHHY MEEEEE?!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
为什...为什么是我？！

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Ar-Arpesto, no!
...........................
Oh. Oh, come on! The arrow
just glanced you! You'll be
alright. Quit being a baby.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
阿-阿尔佩斯托，不！
...........................
哦。哦，拜托！箭只是擦过你而已！
你没事的。别像个婴儿一样大惊小怪。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Eh, don't worry about
Arpesto. He's just being
a crazy old man. I'll take
care of him, so just make
sure you make good use
of that new skill. Take care~
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
呃，别担心阿尔佩斯托。
他只是个疯老头。我会照顾他的，你只要好好利用那个新技能就好。再见~

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Hurry up and bring
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then, I can teach you
the Emergency Arrow skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
快点给我带来^3131FF5颗诅咒红宝石^000000、^3131FF30份宠物饲料^000000和^3131FF5根哈比的羽毛^000000。
然后，我就可以教你紧急箭技能了。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ah, very nice.
Um, as you demonstrated
earlier, my teaching technique
was perfect. But next time, use
the skill on foes that deserve
to be beaten, alright? Good.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
啊，非常好。
嗯，正如你刚才展示的那样，我的教学技巧是完美的。但下次，请对那些该被打败的敌人使用这个技能，好吗？很好。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Did the master send you
to me? Hmm... You're still
pretty green from the looks
of it. Yeah, I don't think there's anything I can teach quite yet.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
是师父派你来的吗？嗯...
看你的样子，经验还不足。
是的，我觉得我暂时没什么可以教你的。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Train a little more and get
some more experience in
your job. When you become
more adept at hunting, you'll
be able to grasp what I've been
teaching Hunters and Snipers.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
多训练一下，在你的职业上多积累一些经验。
当你狩猎技巧更加娴熟时，你就能掌握我教给猎人和神射手的技巧了。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Has the master sent you?
Ah, you definitely have the
keen, vulture like eyes of a
true Hunter. You should be
capable of learning my secret
skill, the 3rd Arpesto Form...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
是师父派你来的吗？
啊，你绝对拥有一双真正的猎人那锐利如秃鹫般的眼睛。
你应该有能力学习我的秘密技能，阿尔佩斯托第三式...

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
It's a handy skill that
I developed while battling
Medusas and running out
of arrows. I simply call it,
''^3131FFEmergency Arrow^000000.'' Would you
be interested in learning it?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
这是一个实用的技能，是我在与米杜沙战斗时箭矢用尽后开发出来的。我简单地称之为“^3131FF紧急箭^000000”。你愿意学习它吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please!
scripts.translation: 好的，请教我！

scripts.text: Ummm...

[Arpesto]
Great, great. Of course,
you can't resist this offer
if you recognize this skill's
value. However, I'd like to
ask for a little tuition in return for me teaching this to you.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
很好，很好。当然，如果你认识到这个技能的价值，你就无法拒绝这个提议。不过，我想在教你这个技能的同时，收取一点学费。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Although I feel guilt at
asking for payment from
a fellow Hunter, creating
this skill required much
sacrifice and unimaginable
bloodshed on my part...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
虽然向同为猎人的你收取费用让我感到愧疚，但创造这个技能需要我付出巨大的牺牲和难以想象的鲜血...

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
Hey! You liar!
I was there when you
accidently made up that
skill when you were bored
and just messing around
with one of the Bows!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
嘿！你这个骗子！
我亲眼看到你无聊时胡乱摆弄一把弓，不小心发明了那个技能！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
^333333*Ahem*^000000 Please Reidin,
don't entertain unfounded
rumors. It was only after
countless battles with Eddga
that I managed to invent and
perfect Emergency Arrow.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
^333333*咳咳*^000000拜托了，雷丁，不要传播没有根据的谣言。
正是在与虎王无数次战斗后，我才发明并完善了紧急箭。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
^333333*Tsk tsk*^000000 Huh.
I thought you said
you developed it while
you were fighting Medusas.
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
^333333*啧*^000000哼。
我还以为你说你是在和米杜沙战斗时开发出来的呢。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
A-anyway, please bring
me the following items
as tuition in exchange for
me teaching you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
不-不管怎样，请给我带来以下物品，作为我教你这个技能的学费。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Please bring me
^3131FF5 Cursed Rubies^000000,
^3131FF30 Pet Foods^000000 and
^3131FF5 Harpy Feathers^000000.
Then I can teach
you this skill.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
请给我带来^3131FF5颗诅咒红宝石^000000、^3131FF30份宠物饲料^000000和^3131FF5根哈比的羽毛^000000。
这样我就可以教你这个技能了。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
30 Pet Foods?
What the heck do
you need all that for?
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
30份宠物饲料？
你要那么多干什么？

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
I...
I'm going to
use it to feed
my pet Falcon.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
我...
我要用它来喂我的宠物猎鹰。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
...
......
.........
......Riiiight.

[Arpesto]
Alright, it's your
decision. However, I'm
sure that you may have
great need of my skill
sooner or later, so return
to me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
好吧，这是你的决定。不过，我相信你迟早会非常需要我的技能，如果你改变主意了，就回来找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
The sky still looks clear, but recently the winds that have been blowing through the land seem to carry with them an air of misfortune.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
天空看起来依然晴朗，但最近吹过这片土地的风，似乎带着不祥的气息。

scripts.text:
[Reidin Corse]
So...
Danger's coming?
Heh! Chill, gramps~
I got it covered!
scripts.translation:
[雷丁·科斯]
所以...
危险要来了？
嘿！别担心，老爷爷~
交给我吧！

scripts.text:
[Arpesto]
Ho ho...
Energetic, but
cocky. Kids nowadays...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔佩斯托]
呵呵...
精力充沛，但有点自大。现在的年轻人...
